v: Ha jun syalkan tik ix uji ayik ayoch winhaj Asuero reyal t'a Persia. 127 makanhil yaj smakb'en winh chi', skot t'a India masanto sk'och t'a Etiopía.
Haxo t'a chonhab' Susa, hata' ay spalacio winh rey chi'.

Ayik yoxil ab'il yoch winhaj Asuero chi' reyal, ix yak'an jun niwan wa'el winh t'a heb' niwak winak ayoch yajalil yet'ok, haton heb' yajalil heb' soldado yik Persia, heb' yik Media, heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' ayoch yajalil t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh chi'.
Nanhal ab'il wal ix yak' jun k'inh chi' winh, yik sch'oxanel jantak sb'eyumal winh yet' sniwanil yelk'och yopisio winh t'a heb' awtab'il chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch ukexo k'uhal k'inh winh t'a yamak'il spalacio. Masanil heb' ayek' t'a chonhab' Susa chi', heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, ix awtaj heb' smasanil.

Te wach' ix aj sb'o b'aj ix och k'inh chi'. Ha k'apak saksak k'apak yet' k'apak ya'ax ix och scortina'ilok. Hanhejtona' pax k'apak lino saksak yet' k'apak k'ik' mutz'inak ayoch sch'anhalok pax k'apak cortina chi'. Yamb'il k'apak yuj k'e'en argolla nab'a plata ayoch t'a juntzanh k'e'en oy nab'a mármol. Haxo xila, ha k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata ayoch t'ay. Haxo t'a sat lu'um, ha k'e'en mármol ayem t'ay, ay k'e'en saksak, ay k'e'en k'ik'ik'.
Haxo juntzanh waso nab'a oro syuk'lab'ej heb'. Ch'okch'ok yilji junjun waso chi'. Te niwan wino ix el t'a sk'o'ol winh rey chi' yak'ani.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ak'an serwil winh to malaj junok mach tz'ak'chaj pural yuk'an wino chi', junjun heb' syal yuk'an heb' jantak snib'ej.
Hanhejtona' pax ix reina Vasti, ix schek pax b'ochaj jun niwan wa'el ix t'a spalacio winh rey chi' yik wach' swa heb' ix ix awtab'il.

Ha wal t'a yukil k'uhal k'inh chi', ix te tzalaj sk'o'ol winh rey chi' yuj wino. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at ukwanh heb' winh yak'umal serwil winh, heb' winh ayoch yipok sk'o'ol winh, haton winhaj Mehumán, winhaj Bizta, winhaj Harbona, winhaj Bigta, winhaj Abagta, winhaj Zetar yet' winhaj Carcas.

Ix chekjib'at heb' winh yik b'at yik'ankot ix reina Vasti chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', yujto snib'ej winh sjawi ix yet' scorona kopopi yilji, yik sch'oxanpaxel swach'il yilji ix t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima yet' t'a yichanh heb' niwak yajal, yujto te wach' yilji ix.
Palta maj stak'kotlaj sb'a ix. Ix stenek' ix tas ix b'at yal heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' ix te kot yowal winh rey chi'.

Ix yawtankot ukwanh heb' winh niwak yopisio t'a Media yet' t'a Persia chi' winh, heb' winh yipk'olal yaj yuj winh: Haton winhaj Carsena, winhaj Setar, winhaj Admata, winhaj Tarsis, winhaj Meres, winhaj Marsena yet' winhaj Memucán. Ha heb' winh chi', yojtak ley heb' winh sik'lab'il, yuj chi' t'a heb' winh ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' tas tz'aj jun chi' sb'o'i.

Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Icha syal ko ley, na'ek wet'ok ¿tas yowalil tz'aj ix reina Vasti chi', yujto maj sk'anab'ajej hin cheknab'il ix, ix b'at yal heb' winh hin chekab'? xchi winh.

Ha wal t'a yichanh masanil heb' molan chi', ix yalan winhaj Memucán t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha ix reina Vasti chi', manhoknhej t'ayach ix och smul ix, palta ix ochpax smul ix t'ayonh ha honh niwak yajal honh tik yet' t'a masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a yol ha makb'en tik.

Ha tas ix sk'ulej ix chi' ol yab' masanil heb' ix ix, ol sk'ayb'an heb' ix, manhxa ol aj yelk'och heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix t'a yol sat, ol am yalan heb' ix icha tik: Ha winhaj rey Asuero ix awtan ix reina Vasti, palta maj sk'anab'ajejlaj ix sb'ati, xcham heb' ix.

Ha heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh niwak yajal t'a Persia yet' t'a Media tik, ayik ol yab'an heb' ix tas ix yutej sb'a ix reina chi', ol laj yalan heb' ix t'a heb' winh yetb'eyum. Yuj chi' ha yuj jun tik ol spatikejel heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, haxo skot yowal heb' winh chi' t'a heb' ix.

Yuj chi' jun mamin rey, tato wach' skan jun tik t'ayach, ak' tz'ib'chaj junok ley yik skan leyal t'a Persia yet' t'a Media tik, to maxtzak yal yek'b'ati: Manhxa b'ak'inh sjawi ix reina Vasti t'a yichanh winh rey, xchiokab' jun ley chi'. Haxo junokxo ix ek'to swach'il t'a yichanh ix chi', ha ix tz'ochkan reina'il sk'exulok ix.
Ha jun ley chi' yowalil tz'ak'chaj ojtakajel t'a masanil yol ha makb'en tik yik wach' masanil heb' ix ix ol sk'anab'ajej wal heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, yalnhej tas anima'il, xchi winh.
Ha jun ix yal winhaj Memucán chi', ix scha wal sk'o'ol winh rey chi' yet' masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh, ix och t'a yopisio yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix schekan winh tz'ib'chajb'at t'a junjun makan t'a yol smakb'en chi', t'a sti' junjun chonhab'. Ix yalanb'at winh to ayokab' yelk'och heb' winh winak t'a yol spat, a'okab' heb' winh tz'alani tastak sb'o'i.
Ix ek' junok tiempo'al, ix sikb'i yowal sk'o'ol winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Ix sna'ankot winh tas ix sk'ulej ix Vasti chi' yet' pax jun ley ix alchajel yuj ix.
Yuj chi' haxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh t'a yol smakb'en chi', ix yal heb' winh icha tik: --Yowalil saychajkot heb' ix kob'estak t'a winh rey tik, haton heb' ix te wach' yilji.

Sik'okab' winh rey tik junjunok schekab' t'a junjun makan t'a yol smakb'en tik, yik wach' ha heb' winh tz'ik'ankot masanil heb' ix kob'estak te wach' yilji. Sjawi heb' ix t'a spalacio winh t'a chonhab' Susa tik, tz'ochkan heb' ix t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hegai, winh stanhwan heb' ix yetb'eyum winh rey tik. Ha winh tz'ak'an serwil heb' ix yik ste b'o yilji heb' ix.

Ha junok ix kob'es ol scha sk'o'ol winh rey tik, haton ix ol ochkan reina'il sk'exulok ix Vasti chi', xchi heb' winh. Ha jun pensar chi', ix scha wal sk'o'ol winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix schek winh k'ulaj icha chi'.
Ha t'a chonhab' Susa chi', hata' kajan jun winh israel skuchan Mardoqueo yuninal winhaj Jair yinhtilal winhaj Simei. Ha winhaj Simei chi', ha winhaj Cis ay yinhtilal winh t'a yinhtilal Benjamín.
Ha heb' smam yicham winh, ik'b'ilkot heb' yuj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor t'a Jerusalén, jawinakkan heb' t'a Babilonia. Junnhej janakkan heb' yet' winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá.

Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ay jun ix yisil jun winh sk'ab'yok winh ayek' yet'ok, haton ix Hadasa, syalelk'ochi Ester, meb'a' ix, yujto chamnak smam snun ix. Haxo winhaj Mardoqueo chi' ix ilan k'ib' ix, icha wal yisil winh yaj ix. Te wach' yilji sat ix yet' sniwanil.

Haxo yik ix elta jun ley yuj winh rey chi', tzijtum heb' ix kob'estak ix molchaj t'a chonhab' Susa t'a spalacio winh. Ha winhaj Hegai ix ak'chajoch stanhwumalok heb' ix, haton winh stanhwantaxon heb' ix yetb'eyum winh rey chi'. Ayoch ix Ester chi' t'a skal heb' ix.

Te wach' spensar ix ix yiloch winhaj Hegai chi', yuj chi' te wach' ix yutej spensar winh t'a ix. Elanhchamel ix te ak'chaj juntzanh remeyo yik tz'ak'chajoch t'a sniwanil ix yik ste b'o yilji ix, tz'ak'chaj pax wa'el te wach' t'a ix. Ix ak'chajoch ukwanh heb' ix schekab' winh rey te wach' yik tz'ak'ji serwil ix. Ix ak'chajb'at heb' ix yet' ix Ester chi' t'a jun cuarto te wach' b'aj ay heb' ix yetb'eyum winh rey chi'.
Ha ix Ester chi' malaj jab'ok tas ix yal ix tas inhtilal, ma tas chonhab'il ix, yujto ix cham wal yalan winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a ix to max yal-laj ix.
Junjun k'u tz'ek' winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sat b'aj ayek' heb' ix ix chi', yik syab'an winh tato wach' sk'o'ol ix Ester chi' yet' tas tz'aj yak'ji serwil ix.

Masanil juntzanh heb' ix kob'estak chi', jun ab'il ix b'ochaj yilji heb' ix. T'a sb'ab'elal wake' ujal sukchajek' aceite yik mirra t'a sniwanil heb' ix. Haxo t'a junxo wake' ujal, sukchajek' perfume yet' crema t'a heb' ix ichataxon juntzanh sk'an heb' ix ix. Haxo yik ix el yab'ilal sb'ochaj yilji heb' ix chi', junjunal ix ik'jib'at heb' ix yik sway heb' ix yet' winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'och junjun heb' ix t'a winh rey chi'. Ayik tz'elta heb' ix b'aj ayek' heb' ix kob'estak chi', syalnhej sk'anan heb' ix tastak snib'ej yik sb'o'an sb'a heb' ix.

Sb'at heb' ix t'a spalacio winh rey chi' t'a yemk'uhalil, haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, sk'ochkan heb' ix t'a junxo pat b'aj ay heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh rey chi', b'aj ayoch winhaj Saasgaz yilumalok heb' ix yuj winh rey chi'. Majxo k'ochlaj heb' ix t'a winh rey chi', anhej tato ay junok heb' ix te wach', scha sk'o'ol winh, ha jun ix chi' tz'awtaj sb'i, sb'at ix b'i'an.

Haxo ix aji, ayik ix k'och stzolal t'a yib'anh ix Ester yisilkan winhaj Abihail, sk'ab'yok winhaj Mardoqueo chi', yik b'at way ix yet' winh rey chi', anhej tas ix yal winhaj Hegai stanhwumal heb' ix, anhej ix yik'b'at ix. Te wach' ix Ester chi' t'a yol sat masanil heb' tz'ilan ix.
Ayik slajunhil uj, t'a jun uj skuchan Tebet, ayik yukil ab'il yoch winhaj Asuero reyal, hata' ix ik'chajb'at ix t'a spalacio winh yik sway ix yet' winh.

Yelxo wal te xajan ix Ester chi' yuj winh rey chi'. Malaj junokxo ix te xajan yuj winh. Te niwan swach'k'olal winh ix sch'ox t'a ix t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' ix kob'estak chi'. Yuj chi' ix schek winh ak'chajk'e jun corona t'a sjolom ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankanoch ix winh reina'il sk'exulok ix Vasti.

Ix schekan b'ojok jun niwan wa'el winh yik tz'ik'jicha'anh ix Ester chi'. Ix yawtan masanil heb' yajal ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Ix yik'anemta sb'isul k'e'en tumin winh ayoch t'a yib'anh heb' anima yak'ani. Te tzijtum pax tas ix yak' winh t'a juntzanh nación ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sch'oxanel swach'k'olal winh rey chi'.
Ayik toxo ix k'exchaj b'aj kajan heb' ix kob'estak chi', ayik ayxo och winhaj Mardoqueo t'a yopisio t'a spalacio winh rey,
ha ix Ester chi' hanheja' max yal-laj ix tas chonhab'il ix, tas yinhtilal ix. Hanheja' sk'anab'ajan ix tas syal winhaj Mardoqueo chi', icha ix sk'anab'ajej ix ayik ayek' ix t'a spat winh.

Ha jun'el, ayik ix k'och stzolal t'a yib'anh winhaj Mardoqueo t'a yopisio t'a palacio winh rey chi', ay chawanh heb' winh stanhwan b'aj ay winh rey chi', haton winhaj Bigtán yet' winhaj Teres. Te aykot yowal heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', wan yalan heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh smilancham winh rey chi'.

Ix yab'an winhaj Mardoqueo tas wan yalan heb' winh chi', haxo winh ix chekan aljok t'a ix reina Ester chi'. Haxo ix ix halan t'a winh rey chi' to ha winhaj Mardoqueo ix ab'an tas wan yalchaj t'a spatik winh.

Haxo ix sk'anb'an winh yab'i, ix cheklaji to yel jun lolonel ix yal winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Yuj chi' ha chawanh heb' winh stanhwumal winh rey chi', ix k'e lokan heb' winh t'a te te'. Ha jun ix uji chi' ix stz'ib'chajkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal winhaj rey Asuero ayik ix yak'an reyal winh.

Ixlajwi yek' juntzanh chi', ix yak'anoch yopisio winhaj Amán yuninal winhaj Hamedata yinhtilal winhaj Agag winh rey chi'. Ix ak'ji'och winh sat yajalil t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'.

Masanil heb' winh tz'ak'an serwil winh rey chi', yowalil tz'em kuman heb' winh, tz'empax nhojan heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Amán chi', yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan winh rey chi'. Haxo pax winhaj Mardoqueo chi', max sk'anab'ajejlaj jun cheknab'il chi' winh.
Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' tas yuj max sk'anab'ajej jun cheknab'il chi' winh.

Junjun k'u syalan heb' winh t'a winh, palta max schalaj yab' winh tas syal heb' winh chi', yujto toxo ix yal winh t'a heb' winh to israel winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Amán chi' yik syilan heb' winh tato tonhej ol yiloch winh winhaj Amán chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Amán to yel max emlaj kuman winhaj Mardoqueo chi', max empax nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh ayik tz'ek' winh, ix te kot yowal winh.

Toxo ix yab' winh to israel winhaj Mardoqueo chi', yuj chi' ix sna'an winh to manhoknhej winh smiljichamok, palta ix sna'a winh tas tz'aj satji'el masanil heb' israel ayek' t'a yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi'.

Ha t'a b'ab'el uj skuch Nisán, yik slajchawil ab'il yoch winhaj Asuero reyal, ix och suerte t'a yichanh winhaj Amán yik syil winh tas k'uhal, ma tas tiempo'al ol elk'och jun tas sna'a winh chi'. Haxo ix aji, ha t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar, ix cheklaj sk'uhal.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a masanil chonhab' ay t'a yol ha makb'en, ay jun makan anima ch'ok yeli. Ch'ok yel sley heb' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab', max sk'anab'ajej ha ley heb'. Manh smojok skajnaj heb' t'a yol ha makb'en tik.

Yuj chi' mamin rey, tato scha ha k'o'ol, ak'elta junok ley yik syab' masanil chonhab' to satel juntzanh anima chi'. Tato icha chi' ol wak' junok 7,500 quintal k'e'en plata b'aj smolchaj k'e'en tz'ak'ji t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix scha sk'o'ol winh rey tas ix yal winh chi', yuj chi' ix yik'el skolk'ab' winh b'aj ayoch sello, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Amán chi', haton winh ajk'o'ol t'a heb' israel.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Ha k'e'en plata ix al chi', kanokab' k'e'en t'ayach, haxo heb' anima tzal chi', ik yaj heb', syal tza k'ulej tas nab'il uj t'a yib'anh heb', xchi winh t'a winh.

Ayik 13 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il chi', ix awtaj masanil heb' winh stz'ib'um winh rey chi' yik stz'ib'an jun ley chi' heb' winh ix yak'elta winhaj Amán chi', yik sb'at t'a masanil heb' yajal t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'. Ha jun ley chi' ix tz'ib'chaj t'a sti' yet' t'a sletra'il junjun chonhab'. Ix och sb'i winh rey chi' t'ay yet' sello winh.

Elanhchamel ix chekjib'at heb' winh chekab' t'a masanil yol smakb'en winh rey chi'. Syalan jun ley chi' to junnhej k'uhal ol satji'el masanil heb' israel yet' masanil heb' yuninal heb'. Haxo tastak ay t'a heb', ol ik'chajkanek' smasanil. Ha jun k'u ix cheklaj chi', haton t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar.
Ix pukax jun ley chi' t'a masanil smakb'en winh rey chi'. Ix alchajel t'a skal masanil anima yik wach' listaxo yaj heb' anima t'a jun k'u chi'.

Elanhchamel ix pukaxb'at jun ley chi' icha ix aj yalan winh rey chi'. B'ab'el ix alchajel t'a yol chonhab' Susa. Yakb'an wan yuk'an anh winh rey yet' winhaj Amán chi', haxo heb' anima t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix te somchajcha'anh heb' yuj jun ley chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Mardoqueo masanil tas ix alchaj chi', ix snik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal, ix yak'anoch pichul yik kusk'olal winh, ix yak'ank'e k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh winh t'a sjolom, ix och ijan winh yek' t'a kal chonhab'. Tz'el yaw winh yuj kusk'olal.
Haxo yik ix k'och winh t'a sti' spalacio winh rey, maj ochlaj winh t'a yo'ol, yujto max chaji'ochlaj junok mach yuj winh rey chi' tato ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj.

Hanhejtona' t'a masanil chonhab' b'ajtak ix tz'ib'chajb'at jun ley chi', masanil heb' israel ix och t'a kusk'olal. Ayik ix sch'oxanel skusk'olal heb' chi', ix och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Tz'ok' heb', tz'el yaw heb', tzijtum heb' ix sjulek' jichan sb'a t'a skal k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh, ix yak'anoch pichul heb' yik kusk'olal.

Ha heb' ix ix tz'ak'an serwil ix reina Ester yet' heb' winh winak stanhwan ix, ix yal heb' yab' ix tas yaj winhaj Mardoqueo chi', yuj chi' ix te kus sk'o'ol ix, ix yak'anb'at pichul ix t'a winh yik syik'anel pichul yik kusk'olal ayoch chi' yuj winh, palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh ix scha'a.

Haxo ix Ester chi' ix awtankot jun winh schekab' winh rey skuch Hatac, schekab' pax winh ix. Ix schekanb'at winh ix t'a winhaj Mardoqueo yik b'at sk'anb'ej winh tas wan yuji, tas pax yuj icha chi' syutej sb'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'och winhaj Hatac chi' b'aj ayek' winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a jun parque t'a yichanh sti' spalacio winh rey chi', ix lolon winh yet' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Mardoqueo masanil tastak tz'alchaj chi' t'ay yet' pax jantak sb'isul k'e'en plata syaltej winhaj Amán yik tz'och b'aj smolchaj k'e'en stumin winh rey yik wach' satji'el masanil heb' israel yalan winh.

Ix yak'anpax jun scopia'il jun ley chi' winh t'a winhaj Hatac chi', yik sch'ox winh t'a ix Ester chi' yik syojtakejel ix yuj tas wan yuji t'a chonhab' Susa chi'. Ix yalanpaxb'at winhaj Mardoqueo chi' to stewi ix t'a winh rey, tope wal syal yek'b'at jun ley chi' t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' ix chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta winhaj Hatac chi', ix ul yalan winh t'a ix Ester chi' masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj Mardoqueo chi'.
Ix schekanxib'at winhaj Hatac chi' ix yik b'at yalxi winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' icha tik:

Masanil mach ayoch schekab'ok winh rey yet' masanil chonhab' ayoch t'a yol smakb'en winh, yojtak heb' to ay jun ley tz'alani tato ay mach tz'och t'a yol sti' b'aj ay winh rey t'a spalacio, tato manh awtab'ilok yuj winh rey chi', b'enhej schami, taxonhej winak ma ix. Anhej b'i'an tato syik'k'e sk'okoch winh rey chi', haton jun nab'a oro, sch'oxanelta winh t'ay, ha jun chi' max chamlaj. Ha hin tik, ayxo jun ujal max hin awtaj yuj winh rey chi', xchib'at ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Hatac t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' masanil tas ix yal ix Ester chi'.
Yuj chi' ix spakanxi winh tas ix yal ix chi': Manh ha nalaj to yujnhej to ayach ek' t'a spalacio winh rey chi' ol hach kolchajok yakb'an masanil heb' ketchonhab' ol cham heb'.

Tope yuj jun sjawi t'a kib'anh tik jun, yuj chi' ix hach sik'chajoch reina'il, yik tzonh ha kolani. Palta tato malaj tas ol al tikne'ik, b'ajam ol kot junok mach ol honh kolanok, palta ha hach tik ol hach satel yet' masanil heb' ha k'ab'ok, xchib'at winh.
Ix yalanxib'at ix Ester chi' t'a winh icha tik:

Ixik, molb'ej masanil heb' ketchonhab' kajan t'a chonhab' Susa tik, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal wu'uj, malaj jab'ok tas tze wa'a, malaj pax tas tzeyuk'ej oxe'ok k'uhal oxe'ok ak'wal. Ol och pax heb' ix tzin ak'an serwil t'a tzek'ojk'olal wet'ok. Ol lajwok chi', ol hin b'at wil winh rey chi', wach'chom manh ichokta' yalan ley. Taxonhej tzin cham jun, chamok hin okab'i, xchib'at ix.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Mardoqueo chi' masanil tas ix yal ix chi'.

Haxo yik ix lajwi'ek' oxe' k'uhal chi', ix sb'o'an sb'a ix Ester chi', ix yak'anoch spichul ix yik sreina'il. Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och ix t'a jun amak' ay t'a sti' jun yet'tal winh rey chi', b'aj k'ojanem winh t'a sk'ojnub' yik sreyal.

Ayik ix yilanelta winh to ayek' ix t'a sti'elta chi', ix sch'oxan winh to stzalaj winh yet' ix, ix yak'anelta sk'okoch winh nab'a oro. Ix ochk'och ix, ix och yub'yub' ix t'a snhi' k'e'en k'okoch chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tas tzach ik'an reina Ester? ¿Tas tza nib'ej? Tato tza nib'ej tza k'an nanhalok hin makb'en tik, syal wak'an t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix tak'wi ix icha tik:
--Mamin rey, tato syal ha k'o'ol, ay jun niwan wa'el ix wak' b'ochajok to tzach kot wa'el tikne'ik yet' winhaj Amán, yujto niwan elk'och t'a yol hin sat, xchi ix. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
--Awtejekkot winhaj Amán t'a elanhchamel to sk'anab'ajaj masanil tas snib'ej ix reina Ester tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh rey yet' winhaj Amán t'a jun niwan wa'el ix sb'o ix Ester chi'.
Ayik wan yuk'an wino heb', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix icha tik: --k'an masanil tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, wach'chom tza k'an nanhalok hin makb'en tik, syal wak'an t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha wal tas tzin nib'ej tzin k'an t'ayach haton tik:

Tato yel xajan hin hu'uj, tato b'ekan ha k'o'ol ak'an tas tzin k'ana', scha'okab' ha k'o'ol ha kotxi wa'el k'ik'an yet' winhaj Amán tik. Ol hin chek b'ochaj junokxo wa'el, yujto te niwan elk'och t'a yol hin sat. Hato k'ik'an chi' swal t'ayach tas tzin nib'ej, xchi ix.

Ix te tzalaj winhaj Amán ayik ix elta winh b'aj ix och wa'el chi', palta ayik ix yilan winh to ayek' winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sti' spalacio winh rey chi', ix te kot yowal winh yujto ayik ix ek' winh ta', maj k'elaj linhan winhaj Mardoqueo chi', maj empax nhojan winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi' maj sch'oxel-laj schichonk'olal winh chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och winh t'a spat, ix yawtankot juntzanh heb' yamigo winh, ix yawtanpaxkot ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Zeres.

Ix och ijan winh yik'ancha'anh sb'a, ix yalan jantak sb'eyumal winh t'a heb', tzijtum pax yuninal winh. Ix yalanpax winh to ix sik'chajelta winh yuj winh rey t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet'ok, ix ak'chajoch winh yajalilok juntzanh heb' winh chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh icha tik: --Hanhejtona' ha hinnhej ix hin awtajb'at wa'el yet' winh rey t'a jun niwan wa'el yuj ix reina Ester. Awtab'il hin pax wa'el yet' winh rey chi' k'ik'an t'a junxo niwan wa'el syak' ix t'a winh rey chi'.
Palta ayik swilanoch jun winh israel skuchan Mardoqueo k'ojanem t'a sti' spalacio winh rey chi', masanil juntzanh tas ay t'ayin tik, manhxa jab'ok yelk'och t'a yol hin sat, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal ix yetb'eyum winh chi' yet' heb' yamigo winh chi' icha tik: --Ak' b'ochajem junok te te' jun ch'anhil tz'ajk'e ste'el. Tza k'anan t'a winh rey chi', haxo k'ik'an k'inhib'al sk'e t'unhan winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a te', yik wach' tzalajk'olal tzach b'at t'a jun niwan wa'el yet' winh rey chi', manhxa jab'ok tas tza na'a, xchi heb'. Ha jun pensar chi' ix scha sk'o'ol winhaj Amán chi', ix schekan winh b'ojok jun te te' chi'.
Ha wal t'a jun ak'wal chi', maj ochlaj swayanh winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh to tz'ik'chajkot juntzanh b'aj tz'ib'ab'il yab'ixal tastak ujinak t'a yol smakb'en winh chi', ix awtaj yab' winh.

Ix ilchaj b'aj syala' to ha winhaj Mardoqueo ix halani tas yalnak winhaj Bigtán yet' winhaj Teres, stanhwumal sti' spalacio winh rey chi'. Ix sna'a heb' winh tas syutej smilancham winhaj rey Asuero chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh ayoch yopisio yuj winh: --¿Tas ak'b'il yet' tas utajnak winhaj Mardoqueo yuj jun tas sk'ulejnak winh tik? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh: --Malaj wal jab'ok tas ak'b'il t'a winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Mach jun ayek' t'a yamak'il palacio tik? Ixikek heyila', xchi winh. Ha wal ta' wan sjawi winhaj Amán yik tzul sk'anan winh t'a winh rey chi' to tz'ak'chajk'e lokan winhaj Mardoqueo t'a jun te te' toxo ix schek b'ojok winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi': --Ha winhaj Amán ayek'i, xchi heb' winh. --Ix yalan winh rey chi' to tz'awtajoch winh b'aj ayek' winh chi'.

Ix och winhaj Amán chi' b'i'an, ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas smoj tz'utaj junok winh winak, tato tzin nib'ej swik'cha'anh winh? xchi winh. Ix sna'an winhaj Amán chi' t'a spensar icha tik: ¿Machto wal junok ol yik'cha'anh winh rey tik? Ha hinnhej toni, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha wal tas smoj tz'utaj junok winak chi',
to tz'ik'chajkot junok ha pichul tza k'an t'a opisio tik yet' nok' ha chej tza k'antaxoni. Haxo t'a sjolom nok' tz'ak'chajk'e junok yelwanub' icha corona, ha sch'oxani to ik nok'.

Haxo jun ha pichul chi' yet' nok' chej chi' tz'ak'chaj t'a junok heb' winh yajal to niwan yelk'och yopisio tik, syak'anoch ha pichul jun winh tza nib'ej tzik'cha'anh chi'. Tz'ak'chajk'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' ha chej chi', slajwi chi' sketzchaj nok' t'a yalanh winh t'a yoltak calle yet' t'a parque. Syalan winh ketzjinak nok' chi' icha tik: Ichaton tik tz'aj yik'jicha'anh junok winh winak snib'ej winh rey syik'cha'anh, xchiokab'i, xchi winhaj Amán chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Amán chi' icha tik: --Ixik t'a elanhchamel, ik'b'at k'apak hin pichul chi' yet' nok' hin chej chi', icha wal ix aj halan chi', icha wal chi' tzutej ha b'o'an winhaj Mardoqueo winh israel, haton winh k'ojanem t'a sti' hin palacio tik. Malajokab' junok tas ix al chi' to max ha k'ulej, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at k'apak pichul chi' winhaj Amán chi' yet' nok' chej chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Ix sketzan nok' chej chi' winh t'a yalanh winh, ix ek' winh t'a yoltak calle yet' t'a parque, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ichaton tik tz'aj yik'jicha'anh junok mach to snib'ej winh rey syik'cha'anh, xchi winh.

Ayik ix lajwi yik'ji'ek' winhaj Mardoqueo chi' yuj winh, ix b'at winh yak'xikan winh t'a sti' spalacio winh rey chi', haxo winh elanhchamel ix paxkan winh t'a spat. Te kusk'olal ix aj winh, ix smakan sat winh yuj k'ixwelal.

Ix yalan winh t'a ix yetb'eyum yet' t'a heb' yamigo masanil tas ix utaj winh chi', yuj chi' ix yal heb' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', israel winh, yuj chi' wan slajwi'em opisio tik t'a spatik winh. Manh ol ak'laj ganar winh, palta to ha winh ol hach ak'an ganar, xchi heb'.
Manto lajwi yalan heb' icha chi', ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' t'a elanhchamel yik tz'ik'jib'at winhaj Amán chi' t'a jun niwan wa'el ix schek b'ojok ix Ester chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh rey yet' winhaj Amán chi' t'a jun niwan wa'el chi'.
Haxo yik wan yuk'an wino heb' winh, ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix Ester chi' icha tik: --k'an tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, wach'chom ha nanhalok hin makb'en tik tza k'ana', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix Ester chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato wach' hin t'a yol ha sat, tato scha ha k'o'ol tas tzin k'an t'ayach, anhej wal tas tzin k'an t'ayach to max hin ha cha miljokchamok, max champaxlaj heb' wetchonhab'.

Yujto ha hin tik yet' heb' wetchonhab' chi', ix honh chonhchaji yik tzonh satji'el t'a jun'elnhej. Komonok wal tonhej honh chonhchajb'at chekab'ok, tato icha chi' tekan manh smojok to swik'ek' ha tiempo, okxo jun, to ol honh satjokel t'a jun'elnhej, xchi ix.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj rey Asuero chi' icha tik: --¿Mach jun chi'? ¿B'ajtil ay jun mach sna'an jun tzal chi'? xchi winh.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ha winh ajk'o'ol chuk spensar chi', haton winhaj Amán tik, xchi ix. Ha wal yik ix yab'an jun lolonel winhaj Amán chi', sakxonhej ix aj yilji sat winh yuj xiwelal t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh ix reina Ester chi'.

Ix k'e wan winh rey chi', ix te kot yowal winh, ix elta winh t'a yol pat b'aj wan swa heb' chi'. Ix el winh b'aj ay yamak'il spalacio. Palta haxo winhaj Amán chi', ix yilan winh to wan yak'ji'och chamel t'a yib'anh winh, ix kannhej winh b'aj ix wa heb' chi', ix tewi'och winh t'a ix reina Ester chi' to tz'ak'ji niwank'olal winh yuj ix.

Ayik ix ochxik'och winh rey b'aj ix wa chi', ix yilan winh to kumanem winhaj Amán chi' t'a stz'ey b'aj k'ojanem ix reina chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tom tza nib'ej tzixtej ix reina t'a wichanh t'a yol hin pat tik? xchi winh. Ayik ix yalan juntzanh lolonel winh rey chi', elanhchamel ix makchaj sat winhaj Amán chi' yuj heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh chekab' skuchan Harbona icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a spat winhaj Amán tik, ix yak' b'ochajem jun te te' winh jun ch'anhil ix ajk'e ste'el. Hata' ol k'e lokan winhaj Mardoqueo yuj winh yalani, haton winh sk'ulejnak jun tas wach' t'ayach, xchi winh. --Hak'ekk'e lokan winhaj Amán tik t'a jun te te' chi', xchi winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'e lokan winhaj Amán chi' t'a te', haton te' ix sb'ok'e winh yuj winhaj Mardoqueo yalani. Icha chi' ix aj sikb'i yowal sk'o'ol winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil tas ay t'a winhaj Amán, winh ajk'o'ol yajoch t'a heb' israel, ix yak' winh rey chi' t'a ix Ester. Haxo winhaj Mardoqueo chi', niwan yopisio winh ix ak'ji yuj winh rey chi', yujto toxo ix yal ix Ester chi' to te ayto yuj sb'a ix yet' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anel k'e'en skolk'ab' winh rey chi', k'e'en ix ik'chajek' t'a winhaj Amán, ix yak'anoch k'e'en winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Haxo masanil tas ay t'a winhaj Amán ak'b'il t'a ix Ester chi', ix ak'ji'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Mardoqueo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'ochxi ix Ester t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Ix em kuman ix, ix och ijan ix yok'i. Ix tewi ix to tz'ik'ji'el yopisio jun ley te chuk ix sb'o winhaj Amán chi'. Ix yalan ix to max elk'och tas syal jun ley chi' t'a heb' israel.
Ix yak'anelta sk'okoch winh rey chi' nab'a oro t'a ix, ix k'e linhan ix t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato wach' hin t'a yol ha sat, tato wach' tas tzin k'an tik tzab'i, tato t'a wal yel xajan hin hu'uj, komonok tzak' tz'ib'chajb'at junokxo ley yik tz'el yopisio tas syal jun ley ix yak'b'at winhaj Amán yuninal winhaj Hamedata yinhtilal winhaj Agag t'a masanil yol ha makb'en b'aj syala' to satji'el masanil heb' wetchonhab'.
Manh ol techaj wu'uj wilan tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh masanil heb' wetchonhab' yuj tas ol aj ko satji'eli, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Asuero chi' t'a ix yet' t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Amán chi' lokanxok'e winh t'a te te', yujto chuk tas ix snacha'anh winh t'a spatik heb' heyetchonhab'. Masanil tas ay t'a winh, toxo ix wak' t'ayach.

Ha tikne'ik tz'ib'ejb'at icha tas tze na yuj swach'ilok masanil heb' heyetchonhab' chi'. Tzeyak'anoch hin b'i yet' hin sello t'ay. Yujto ha junok ley b'aj ayoch hin b'i yet' hin sello t'ay, maxtzak yal-laj yek'i, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix awtaj heb' winh stz'ib'um winh rey chi', ayik 23 yoch yoxil uj skuch Siván. Masanil tas ix yal winhaj Mardoqueo chi' ix tz'ib'chajb'at t'a masanil heb' israel, t'a heb' winh yajal, t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado, t'a masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a 127 makanhil yaj smakb'en winh rey chi', skotto t'a India masanto sk'och t'a Etiopía. Ix tz'ib'chajb'at t'a sti' yet' t'a sletra junjun chonhab' yet' t'a sti' heb' israel.

Ix ochpax sello winhaj rey Asuero t'ay yik scheklaji to ha winh tz'alani. Ha heb' ix b'at spuk jun ley chi', ha t'a yib'anh nok' chej jelan sb'eyi, haton nok' schej winh rey ayek' t'a yet'tal, hata' ix k'e heb'.

Ha t'a jun ley ix yalb'at winh rey chi', yalnhej tas chonhab'il b'aj ayek' heb' israel chi', syal smolb'an sb'a heb' yik skolan sb'a heb'. Tato ay heb' ajk'o'ol yalnhej tas chonhab'il sk'och t'a heb' yet' syamk'ab' yik owal, syal satanel heb' ajk'o'ol chi' heb'. Yet' pax yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal heb' ajk'o'ol chi' syal satanel heb'. Syik'ankanek' heb' tas ay t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'.
Ha juntzanh tik, junnhej k'uhal tz'aj sb'o t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', haton t'a jun k'u chekel yajkan t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar.

Ha scopia'il jun ley chi', yowalil spukax t'a junjun makanhil yaj smakb'en winh rey chi', yowalil tz'alchajel t'a skal masanil chonhab' yujto ley yaji, yik wach' ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil heb' israel chi' syak' lista sb'a heb' yik spakan sb'a heb' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'.

Ha heb' winh ix b'at yal jun ley chi', elanhchamel ix chekjib'at heb' winh yuj winh rey chi', ix k'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' schej winh. Ix alchajpaxel jun ley chi' t'a chonhab' Susa chi', b'ab'el chonhab' yaj t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'.

Ayik ix elta winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sdespacho winh rey chi', ayoch spichul winh yik yopisio yuj, k'ik'mutz'inak yet' saksak yilji. Ayk'e jun niwan corona nab'a oro t'a sjolom winh, ayoch jun xotil winh nab'a lino k'ik'mutz'inak yilji. Masanil heb' anima ay t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix awajk'e heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Yuj chi' ha heb' israel ix el lenaj ix yil heb', ix te tzalaj heb', yujto ix ik'jicha'anh heb' ix yab'i.

Ayik ix k'och jun ley chi' t'a masanil lugar yet' t'a junjun chonhab', masanil heb' israel ix te tzalaji. Ix yak'anoch jun k'inh heb', ix wa heb'. Tzijtum heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' ix yak'och sb'a israelal yet' heb', yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' israel chi'.

Ayik 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar, haton jun k'u chi' chekel yaji yik tz'elk'och tas syal jun ley alb'ilel yuj winh rey chi', haton t'a jun k'uhal chi' satji'el heb' israel yuj heb' ajk'o'ol chi' yalani. Haxo ix aji, maj elk'ochlaj icha chi', palta to ha heb' ajk'o'ol chi' ix ak'ji ganar yuj heb' israel chi'.

Ha t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' israel t'a junjun chonhab' b'ajtak ay heb'. Ix syamanoch heb' yak'an owal yet' heb' ix snib'ej satanel heb' chi'. Manhxa junok mach ix stek'b'ej sb'a t'a yichanh heb' israel chi', yujto toxo ix och xiwk'olal t'a skal heb' anima smasanil.
Masanil heb' winh niwak yajal ay t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh rey chi' yet' heb' winh niwak yopisio, ix yak'och sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' israel, yujto ix te xiw heb' winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi',
yujto te niwan yopisio winh t'a spalacio winh rey chi'. Ha sb'inajnakil winh ix te pukax t'a masanil chonhab', yujto t'a junjun k'u ste niwanb'i yopisio winh chi'.
Ix miljicham heb' ajk'o'ol chi' t'a k'e'en espada yuj heb' israel chi'. Ix satji'el heb' smasanil, ix sk'ulej heb' israel chi' icha wal tas snib'ej.

Ha t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ay 500 heb' winh winak ix miljicham yuj heb' israel chi', palta malaj wal jab'ok tastak ay t'a heb' winh ix cham chi' ix yik'ek' heb'. Ha t'a skal heb' winh ix cham chi', ix cham heb' winh tik: Winhaj Parsandata, winhaj Dalfón, winhaj Aspata, winhaj Porata, winhaj Adalías, winhaj Aridata, winhaj Parmasta, winhaj Arisai, winhaj Aridai yet' winhaj Vaizata. Ha winhaj Amán ajk'o'ol t'a heb' israel, winh yuninal winhaj Hamedata, ha winh ay yuninal heb' winh slajunhwanhil.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ayik ix yab'an winh rey jantak sb'isul heb' anima ix cham t'a chonhab' Susa chi', haton b'aj kajan winh,

ix yalan winh t'a ix reina Ester icha tik: --Ha heb' etchonhab' toxo ix smilcham 500 heb' winh winak heb' yet' lajunhwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Amán t'a chonhab' Susa tik. Okxom pax t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol hin makb'en tik, jantak am tas ix uji. Al t'ayin tasto tza nib'ej, ol wak' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix Ester chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato syal ha k'o'ol, tzala' to ha k'ik'an sk'ulejxi heb' wetchonhab' t'a chonhab' Susa tik icha tas ix sk'ulej heb' tikne'ik icha yalan ha ley. Tzalan paxi to sk'e lokan sniwanil lajunhwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Amán chi' t'a te te', xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh rey to sk'ulaj icha chi'. Ix alchajel jun ley chi' t'a masanil yol chonhab' Susa chi'. Ix k'e lokan sniwanil lajunhwanh heb' yuninal winhaj Amán chi'.

Masanil heb' israel kajan t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix smolb'ejxi sb'a heb' ayik 14 yoch uj skuch Adar, ix smilancham 300 xo heb' winh winak heb', palta malaj jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' anima chi' ix yik'ek' heb'.

Masanil heb' israel kajan t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a smakb'en winh rey chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' ayik 13 yoch uj chi', yik skolan sb'a heb' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'. 75 mil heb' ajk'o'ol chi' ix smilcham heb', palta malaj jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' ix yik'ek' heb'. Ayik 14 yoch uj chi', ix och wa'an heb' smilancham heb' anima chi', ix yak'anoch k'inh heb' yet' niwak wa'el t'a tzalajk'olal.

Haxo heb' israel kajan t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' yik skolan sb'a heb' t'a 13 yoch uj yet' t'a 14, haxo t'a 15 ix och wa'an heb' smilancham heb' anima chi', ix yak'anoch k'inh heb' yet' niwak wa'el t'a tzalajk'olal.
Haxo pax heb' israel kajan t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' yet' t'a juntzanh aldea malaj smuro'al, ha t'a 14 yoch uj skuch Adar, hata' ix yak'och k'inh heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, ix si'an wa'el heb' t'ay junjun.

Ix schekan tz'ib'chaj masanil juntzanh tas ix uji tik winhaj Mardoqueo, ix schekan winh to tz'ak'chajb'at t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal winh kajan t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', heb' kajan t'a slak'anil yet' heb' kajan t'a najat.
Ix yalanb'at winh to t'a 14 yet' t'a 15 yoch uj Adar t'a junjun ab'il, yowalil tz'och k'inh,

yujto ha t'a juntzanh k'uhal chi' ha heb' israel ix satanel heb' yajk'o'ol. Ha wal t'a jun uj chi', ha skusk'olal heb' yet' yok'elk'olal, ix meltzajkanoch t'a tzalajk'olal. Yuj chi' ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix yak'och k'inh heb' yet' niwak wa'el, ix laj si'an wa'el heb' t'ay junjun, ix yak'an skolwal heb' t'a heb' meb'a'.
Ha jun ley ix schek tz'ib'chaj winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ix ochkan sb'eyb'alok heb' israel chi'.
Yujto ha winhaj Amán ajk'o'ol t'a heb' israel chi', ix yak'och suerte winh t'a yib'anh heb' tas k'uhal satji'el heb' smasanil,

palta yujto ix b'at tewi ix Ester t'a winh rey, yuj chi' ix yak'elta jun ley winh to ha masanil chukal ix sna'a winhaj Amán chi' sk'ulej t'a heb' israel chi', ha t'a yib'anh winh smeltzajkani. Yuj chi' ix ak'jik'e lokan winh yet' heb' yuninal t'a te te'.

Yuj chi' ha juntzanh k'uhal chi' ix skuchkan Purim. Ha jun lolonel chi' syalelk'ochi, juntzanh tastak sk'an heb' t'a suerte'al. Icha syal tas ix tz'ib'ejb'at winhaj Mardoqueo chi' yet' tas ix sk'ulej heb',
ha ix sb'eyb'alej heb' israel chi' yet' yinhtilal yet' pax masanil heb' syak'och sb'a israelal. Yowalil syak'och chab' k'uhal k'inh chi' heb' t'a junjun ab'il, icha sk'uhal ix aj yalchajkani.

Icha chi' ix ajkani yik snachajkot yuj heb' yinhtilal Israel t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh rey yet' t'a junjun chonhab' to yowalil snakot heb', syak'anoch k'inh heb' yik Purim t'a sk'uhal ix cheklajkan chi' t'a masanil tiempo.

Haxo ix reina Ester yisilkan winhaj Abihail yet' winhaj Mardoqueo winh israel, ha t'a sb'i yopisio heb' chi', ix schek heb' tz'ib'chajb'at yuj k'inh yik Purim chi', yik swach' ak'chajoch yip jun ix schek b'ab'laj tz'ib'chajb'at heb'.
Ix schekan heb' pukchajb'at t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal heb' kajan t'a 127 makan yaj smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Ix ak'jib'at stzatzil sk'o'ol heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' yuj.

Ixlajwi chi', ix alchaji to yowalil tz'och k'inh yik Purim t'a sk'uhal chekelxo ix ajkani, icha wal ix yutej winhaj Mardoqueo yet' ix reina Ester chi' yalani. Yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' yet' pax yinhtilal heb' yik snachajkot tzek'ojk'olal yet' kusk'olal.
Ha jun cheknab'il ix yak' ix Ester chi', ha tz'alani tas tz'aj yoch k'inh chi'. Ha jun tik ix schek ix tz'ib'chajkani.
Ix yak'och k'e'en tumin winhaj rey Asuero t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima, haton heb' ay t'a yol smakb'en winh masanto heb' kajan t'a stitak ha' mar, yik syak' k'e'en heb' t'a winh.

Masanil sjelanil winh rey chi' yet' yopisio yet' yab'ixal tas wal yutejnak winh yak'an niwak opisio t'a winhaj Mardoqueo, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal tastak ujinak t'a yol smakb'en Media yet' Persia.

Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ix ochkan winh schab'il yajalil t'a winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal. Te xajan ix ilji winh yuj heb' yetchonhab' chi', yujto ix sayji'ek' swach'il heb' yuj winh, ix yak'an wal yip winh yik wach' tzalajk'olal yet' junk'olal tz'aj heb'.
